newsitem.title: USA: Resource Banchshares merges with Meritage.
newsitem.headline: Resource Banchshares merges with Meritage.

text.p: Resource Bancshares Mortgage Group Inc and privately-held Meritage Corp said Monday that their merger has been consummated, effective April 1.
In the merger, RBMG exchanged approximately $1.75 million of cash and 944,000 shares of its common stock for all the outstanding common stock of Meritage.

The companies said that about 406,000 of the 944,000 RBMG shares were issued contingent upon Meritage achieving specified increasingly higher levels of subprime mortgage production during the 31 months following closing.
Meritage is a wholesale originator of subprime mortgages headquartered in Portland, Oregon. In 1996 it made about $107 million of subprime mortgage loans.
Resource Bancshares is a mortgage banker that originates, buys, sell and services residential, single-family, first-mortgage loans.
